import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    s = np.sin(p[9]*t); c = np.cos(p[9]*t)
    return ((p[0] + p[1]*t + p[2]*s + p[8]*c)/P + p[3]*t + p[4]*P*P
            + p[5] + p[6]*P + p[7]/(P*P) + p[1*0+0+0]*0 + 0.0*np.log(P))

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):

    return ((p[0] + p[1]*t + p[2]*s + p[3]*c)/P + p[4]*t + p[5]*P*P
